title: The jailer's file: submariners on LSD
place_text: a US military base (file found by McKinnon)

tellings.quote: on one site I found the jailer's file. Every military base has a jailer. M. And it's just crazy. You've got guys taking LSD that work on submarines.

plain: Gary McKinnon, a computer hacker who says he got into US military and space agency computers around 2000 to 2002, says that on one military site he found what he calls the jailer's file. He explains that every military base has a jailer, and says the file showed men who worked on submarines taking LSD, a powerful hallucinogenic drug. He tells it as an example of the strange things he says he saw inside those systems.
